source_checks.claim: BFloat16 contains a uint16_t word and uses one sign bit, eight exponent bits and seven fraction bits. CPU BF16-to-FP32 conversion shifts that uint16 word left by 16 before a memcpy into float. The source supplies infinity bits 0x7F80, quiet NaN bits 0x7FC0, finite max 0x7F7F and denorm minimum 0x0001.
source_checks.comparison: Source P02; locators: struct BFloat16 lines 3-4,27-43; detail::f32_from_bits lines 64-80; operator float lines 139-147; numeric_limits lines 421-475. Scope: Exact installed header SHA256 matches this fixed commit. Together with NP03, supports the native exponent-mask check without widening. Contrary/different scope: numeric_limits reports is_iec559=false; this report does not claim full IEEE-754 conformance. CPU raw storage evidence is distinct from NPU arithmetic behavior. Remaining gap: Source-derived bit and finite classification only; no on-device representation experiment.

source_checks.claim: view_dtype copies the Storage handle into a new TensorImpl using the requested type metadata. For equal item sizes, shape, strides and storage offset are retained; this branch does not numerically convert elements.
